 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two equal-sized panels and mark cells occupied in both."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A full, constant, nonzero row/column is the panel separator.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))), None)

    if sep_row is not None:
        top = grid[:sep_row]
        bottom = grid[sep_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError("No full separator row or column found")
"
}
